risk_if_not_implemented: Without Non-Persistent Information, security may be bolted on rather than designed in, resulting in structural weaknesses that are costly to remediate and easy to exploit. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3). No threat is rated Likely for this control; threats rated Possible include Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Digital Media Sanitization
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to sanitize digital media with the strength and integrity commensurate with the classification or sensitivity of the information prior to disposal, release out of organizational control or release for reuse.
compensating_control_1.justification: Digital Media Sanitization (DCH-18) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Non-Persistent Information (SEA-17.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Session Termination
compensating_control_2.description: Automated mechanisms exist to log out users, both locally on the network and for remote sessions, at the end of the session or after an organization-defined period of inactivity.
compensating_control_2.justification: Session Termination (CFG-04.5) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Non-Persistent Information (SEA-17.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
